card.name: NSAID warning: used in patients with
card.fires_on: The words 'patients' or 'with' in the NSAID warning sentence 'If [drug] is used in patients with severe heart failure / a recent MI, monitor patients'. It fires right before the condition is named.

modes.label: 'with' after patients
modes.description: The word 'with' right after 'used in patients', before severe heart failure or a recent MI.
modes.example: is used in patients<< with>> severe heart failure, monitor patients for signs

modes.label: 'patients' after used in
modes.description: The word 'patients' right after 'is used in' in the same sentence.
modes.example: If ZYNRELEF is used in<< patients>> with severe heart failure, monitor patients for
